CC1(C(N(C1)C(=O)C(C(C)(C)C)NC(=O)C(F)(F)F)C(=O)NC(CC2CCNC2=O)C#N)C
```

**Molecular Formula:** C₃₇H₄₈N₆O₅S₂

**SMILES:**
```
CC(C)c1nc(cs1)CN(C)C(=O)NC(C(C)C)C(=O)NC(Cc2ccccc2)CC(O)C(Cc3ccccc3)NC(=O)OCc4cncs4
